title: first-touch-coach-overlays-and-checklist-cards
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and prototype a lightweight first-touch coaching surface for users who land in empty workspaces (no projects, no routes, no models). The feature combines contextual coach overlays, dismissible checklist cards, and writable templates to reduce time-to-first-success for new users and returning users who need guidance. Focus is on discoverability without interrupting power users. This ticket covers visual design, microcopy, animation specs, analytics hooks, and A/B experiment variants for rollout.
user_stories: As a new developer, I want a short checklist that guides me to create my first route so I can see a live inference request succeed.
As an existing user in a new workspace, I want subtle coach overlays pointing to cost dashboards and rollouts so I can configure SLOs and cost limits quickly.
As a product manager, I want an experimentable coach that we can toggle per workspace to measure conversion to first successful call and retention.
acceptance_criteria: Empty workspace shows a top-level dismissible checklist card with up to 4 suggested next steps (Create Project, Add Model, Run Sample Request, View Cost Overview)
Coach overlays highlight console chrome elements (New Project CTA, Model Catalog, Routes) with context microcopy and an optional 'Try sample' inline action
All coach elements have explicit close/dismiss, snooze for 7 days, and reopen from ? Help menu
Animations are subtle: fade + slide for card entrance, pointer highlight for overlays (specs in Figma file)
Telemetry events emitted for impressions, CTA clicks, dismiss and reopen (events: coach.impression, coach.click, coach.dismiss, coach.reopen)
Design assets and motion specs uploaded to Figma and linked in this ticket
A/B experiment variant A (single persistent card) and variant B (sequential overlays) documented with metric plan (first-success conversion, 7-day retention, cost per user)
Engineering review signoff from ENG-5012 and a PR with UI integration is opened referencing this ticket
prototype_variants: Variant A - Persistent checklist card: single card anchored under console banner with progress checkboxes
Variant B - Sequential micro-overlays: step-by-step overlays that focus users to complete one action at a time
Variant C - Lightweight tooltip bubbles: minimal copy, CTA to 'Try sample' only (control for experiment)
decisions: Keep default state as 'card' (Variant A) for first-time users; overlays reserved for guided tour after card CTA
Microcopy will use active voice and include expected outcome lines (e.g., 'Run a sample request — see a live response in <30s')
Do not auto-start audio or modal interrupts — coach should be non-modal and dismissible
Telemetry event names standardized to coach.* for easier analytics slicing
Snooze option implemented client-side for 7 days; server stores explicit dismiss to avoid reappearing after user dismiss
